messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Annex I, 6.2

6.2. CONTROL DEVICES Where safety requirements do not impose other solutions, the carrier must, as a general rule, be designed and constructed in such a way that persons in the carrier have means of controlling upward and downward movements and, if appropriate, other movements of the carrier. In operation, those control devices must override any other devices controlling the same movement with the exception of emergency stop devices. The control devices for these movements must be of the hold-to-run type except where the carrier itself is completely enclosed.

response.text:
carrier | mustBeDesignedWith | means for persons inside to control upward and downward movements and, if appropriate, other movements | where safety requirements do not impose other solutions | "the carrier must, as a general rule, be designed and constructed in such a way that persons in the carrier have means of controlling upward and downward movements and, if appropriate, other movements of the carrier"
in-carrier control devices | mustOverride | any other devices controlling the same movement | in operation; excludes emergency stop devices | "those control devices must override any other devices controlling the same movement with the exception of emergency stop devices"
control devices for carrier movements | mustBeOfType | hold-to-run type | except where the carrier itself is completely enclosed | "The control devices for these movements must be of the hold-to-run type except where the carrier itself is completely enclosed."
